title: El Salvador
goal: Read how Archbishop Romero's March 1980 assassination opened a twelve-year civil war between the US-backed army and the FMLN, including the December 1981 El Mozote massacre.

items: State what happened to Archbishop Romero on March 24, 1980.
Explain what Romero had requested the day before his death.
Name the two sides of the Salvadoran civil war.
Describe what happened at El Mozote in December 1981.
Use al cabo de to measure elapsed time.
